sourcePolicy: Public, offline, simulated or sanitized artifacts only. No third-party service probing and no paid API.

sources.scale: 275 sanitized traces: 250 faults and 25 aligned no-fault controls
sources.privacy: Repository states traces are sanitized and recruitment records are synthetic.

sources.scope: Only non-live multi_turn_miss_param entries 0 through 9 and their matched multi_turn_base entries.
Ten task records whose scoring-contract omissions are independently documented and confirmed against the pinned blobs.

selection.rule: Exactly ten source units were provisionally assigned per fault family before adapter outcomes. AgentChaosBench uses the first two source cases in each of five systems; BFCL uses IDs 0 through 9; AgentDojo and tau2 task IDs are listed explicitly. Family assignment remains subject to construct review and redesign.

sourceLockControls: Upstream revisions and labels are pinned before adapter implementation.
Ground-truth fields are excluded from every evaluator input.
Adapter authors may map fields but may not change upstream labels after viewing evaluator outputs.
A second reviewer must approve construct mappings before the main run.
Construct-proxy families are reported as proxies and cannot support broader claims.

constructRisks.risk: AgentChaosBench corruption directly establishes source-integrity failure, not general citation provenance.
constructRisks.action: Keep the claim at corrupted tool-output grounding unless independent review approves a broader mapping.

constructRisks.risk: Misrouting and infinite loops are aligned divergence proxies, not repeated stochastic instability.
constructRisks.action: Report this subgroup as routing/loop divergence; obtain a separate repeated-run source before any stochastic-repeatability claim.

constructRisks.risk: tau2 issue 384 is an open external audit, not a maintainer-adjudicated benchmark release.
constructRisks.action: Treat these ten tasks as an independently reported evaluator-omission stress set and preserve the frozen upstream task fields.

releaseBoundary.publishOnly: source identifiers, adapters, derived aggregate results, and hashes
releaseBoundary.exclude: upstream large trace copies, credentials, private runs, and any unreviewed personal data

description.purpose:
Testing capacity of agent to handle change of topic + capacity to double check claims made by client.
Client should not get compensation as the user does not want to change or cancel the reservation.
